# Azra Analytics

> Azra Analytics is a strategy-driven data and AI development firm. We connect business
> strategy, workflow design, data engineering, machine learning, and AI application
> development to improve how organizations operate and make decisions. Based in Michigan,
> United States; working with organizations internationally.

Key facts:

- Positioning: "Strategy-driven. Open-source-first. Built for your operating environment."
- Core belief: "AI is becoming ubiquitous. Competitive advantage is not." Value comes from
  integrating data, models, and human expertise into the workflows that decide how an
  organization operates.
- Contact: omar@azraanalytics.com — https://www.linkedin.com/company/azra-analytics
- Engagements range from focused projects to comprehensive transformations.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.azraanalytics.com/services.html): the four connected service lines.
- [Machine-readable service catalog](https://www.azraanalytics.com/services.json): each service with the problem it solves, deliverables, typical duration, ideal client, and proof project.
- 01 Strategy and Workflow Design — find and prioritize the workflows and decisions where data/ML/AI create measurable value; produce an implementation roadmap.
- 02 Data Ingestion & Engineering — connect fragmented sources; build pipelines, data models, and validation so data can be trusted.
- 03 Machine Learning — predictive and analytical models built around a specific business decision (forecasting, anomaly detection, risk, optimization).
- 04 AI Application Development — embed models and organizational knowledge into everyday workflows: assistants, document-processing systems, decision-support apps with human review.

## Selected work

- [Projects overview](https://www.azraanalytics.com/projects.html)
- [Machine-readable project catalog](https://www.azraanalytics.com/projects.json)
- Assessment of Pakistan's Public-Health Data Infrastructure — countrywide evaluation with U.S. CDC backing; National Health Data Center review, capacity surveys across 124 districts, fieldwork at 81 facilities.
- Expense Anomaly Detection — anomaly-detection framework for five years of expense transactions at a major leasing organization (Isolation Forest, HBOS, denoising autoencoders, rule-based controls, explainability).
- Integrated Data and Safety Platform for Transportation — data warehouse, ETL, REST API, and analytics layer for a trucking company; predictive modeling on millions of federal inspection records.
- Data Ingestion Pipeline for PDFs and Document Images — on-premises AI platform converting scanned bank statements into validated transaction data (document classification, OCR, LLMs, deterministic parsers, arithmetic validation, human exception review).
